shapeSummary: Triangular gusseted 90-degree angle mount: 15x15 mm right-angle profile with truncated tips and a 45-degree hypotenuse face, extruded 14 mm in Y (Y=0 to 14). Each leg has a 4 mm through hole 8 mm from the corner, centered across the width, with an 8 mm counterbore opening on the angled face.
warnings: Counterbore depths are not dimensioned; floors were set at 3 mm from the center plane (about 4 mm hole length left at the leg face).
Internal T-slot/section geometry with 2.25 mm walls was omitted.
Tip truncation size (~3.2 mm) was estimated from drawing proportions.
Axis assignment and hole orientation are assumed from the analysis JSON; the source dimensions are unverified.
